title: A Computational and Conformal Analysis of Multibrot Sets
summary: For the unicritical family $f_{c,j}(z)=z^j+c$, the Multibrot sets $M_j$ converge geometrically to the closed unit disk as $j\to\infty$, but this limit does not quantify their finite-degree area behavior. We estimate Area($M_j$) using escape-time pixel counting while separating the effects of the iteration threshold $K$ and spatial sampling density $ρ$. The finite-iteration sets form a nested decreasing sequence, while grid refinement is treated empirically.
